title: Security Claim Summaries for Sales: Auto-generated one-pagers and negotiable attestation tokens
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Problem: Sales teams often spend multiple rounds with customers to extract and summarize our SIG/CAIQ answers into a concise format usable for negotiations. This slows deals and creates ad-hoc bespoke responses.

Goal: Build a feature that auto-generates a one-page Security Claim Summary (SCS) from our SIG/CAIQ answer corpus and a short negotiable attestation token (NAT) that can be shared with customers and optionally signed for short-term proof. The SCS should be human-readable, highlight high-risk controls, and map directly to the canonical SIG questions. The NAT is a minimal, time-limited statement (TTL-based) that certifies specific claims for X days and links to the full evidence bundle.

Success metrics (experiment): 1) Reduce average sales negotiation time on security checklist items by 30% within pilot accounts; 2) Increase deal velocity (time-to-sign) by 8% for deals requiring attestation; 3) Pilot adoption: 6 POC accounts using SCS+NAT within first 6 weeks.

Scope:
- Input: existing SIG/CAIQ repository + our answers database + approved evidence references.
- Output: downloadable PDF one-pager, email-friendly HTML snippet, and a time-limited JSON attestation token that can be cryptographically signed by Redwood's KMS (optional; toggle per customer).
- UX: Sales console quick-compose + Console > Security > Generate SCS button + API endpoint for programmatic requests.

Out of scope for MVP: full automated evidence packaging (we link to existing evidence locations), automated legal negotiation, and full audit log retention beyond TTL + event log (retained in internal audit system).

Key risks: Legal/regulatory risk if claims are misstated; customers require signatures beyond TTL; scaling signed token issuance could add KMS cost.

Stakeholders: Sales, Legal (Sofia Reyes), Security/Compliance, Console engineering (ENG), Backend KMS/infrastructure, Design (Jonas Müller).
acceptance_criteria: SCS generator produces a readable one-page PDF that maps to >90% of top-25 SIG questions for the customer profile
NAT (JSON token) supports TTL and a pointer URL to the evidence bundle and can be toggled signed/unsigned
Console UI: single-click generation from customer record + email copy button
Experiment A/B plan defined and telemetry wired: negotiation-time, SCS downloads, NAT usage, deal close delta
Legal sign-off on claim templates and token wording for MVP
